jobs.title: Founding Growth Marketer
jobs.description:
About the role
We are on a mission to build real-life JARVIS — a personal AI that can do everything a human assistant can, given natural language instructions. If we succeed, Martin will be the revolutionary consumer product the world has been waiting for since the iPhone.
We launched 6 months ago, and Martin’s capabilities are already light years ahead of legacy assistants like Siri and Alexa. Martin has already executed millions of tasks for over 50,000 users ranging from drafting emails, to scheduling meetings, to making phone calls.
Our company is profitable and funded by top seed investors, including Y-Combinator and Pioneer Fund, and our user base is growing extremely fast.
Come join our founding team in San Francisco as one of our first hires. You’ll have a large impact on the direction of our company, which will be reflected in significant equity compensation. We are building in one of the fastest moving industries ever, and you will have endless opportunities to learn and grow.
If you're passionate about distribution and eager to shape the future of consumer technology, we’d love to hear from you!
Founding Growth Marketer
We are looking for a founding growth marketer to take ownership of our email marketing, paid ads, social media, and other user acquisition channels.
After launching Martin, we’ve grown 10% week over week for over 6 months. Now, in order to grow from $1M to $100M, we need to significantly scale up every component of our distribution.
Our ideal candidate is a fast-learning, versatile marketer who can hit ambitious growth targets repeatedly, through creative tactics and data driven iterations.
Requirements:
3-5 years experience working on GTM teams
Experience running paid ads
Grew a business from $0 to $100,000+ in revenue
SF-based or able to relocate to SF
Bonus:
Experience creating viral social media content from scratch (UGC, ads, or long form videos)
Proficient in graphic design using Figma or Canva
Proficient in landing page design using Webflow or Framer
Expert in copywriting
Key Responsibilities
Manage paid acquisition channels, including Meta Ads, App Store Ads, and Google Ads
Design graphics and static creatives for Meta Ads
Scale our email marketing campaign
Optimize our user acquisition funnel end-to-end, including the landing page, sign up flow, and payment flow
AboutMartin
Martin
is real-life JARVIS. You can text, call or email Martin. He manages your inbox, calendar, to-dos, notes, phone calls, reminders, and more. It is the most advanced AI personal assistant on the market, light years ahead of Siri and Alexa.
5 months since launch, Martin has completed over 500,000 tasks for 30,000 users, and our user base is growing 10% every week. We are funded by top investors like Y-Combinator and Pioneer Fund, and notable angels like the co-founder of DoorDash and former Chief Product Officer of Uber.
Our team is lean but effective, with a culture of shipping fast and obsessing over user experience. We are looking for incredibly ambitious AI engineers + product engineers to join us in creating the most impactful consumer product since the iPhone.

jobs.description:
About the role
MUST APPLY ON ASHBY JOB BOARD:
https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/Tempo/8c316ac8-961c-44e6-a4b3-9cbf4b683919
About Tempo
Tempo is one of Canada’s fastest-growing AI startups, backed by Y Combinator. We’re building a visual IDE for product teams—a platform that merges the craft of design with the rigor of engineering. Designers, PMs, and developers use Tempo to collaboratively ship production-grade web and mobile apps faster than ever before. With a strong focus on design systems, AI-assisted workflows, and real-time collaboration, we’re helping teams move beyond “vibe coding” into a new era of design engineering.
About the Role
We’re looking for a UI/UX Design Engineer to join our in-office team in Toronto — though for an exceptional candidate, we’ll consider a remote arrangement.
This is a leadership position for someone with the experience, creativity, and drive to own our design engineering process end-to-end. You won’t just design screens—you’ll set the standard for how users experience Tempo, shaping our component library, interaction patterns, and AI-driven workflows that thousands of builders will use every day.
As the owner of user experience at Tempo, you’ll collaborate directly with product, engineering, and AI/ML teams to translate complex problems into clear, intuitive, and beautiful interfaces. You’ll bring a strong systems mindset to ensure our design system scales, and the creativity to elevate details like motion, accessibility, and real-time collaboration. This is a role for someone who wants to lead by building—rolling up your sleeves to deliver production-ready components while also driving the vision of design at one of Canada’s most ambitious startups.
What you’ll do
Own end-to-end UI
: Go from concept → flows → wireframes → prototypes → production-ready, high-fidelity UI.
Build real product
: Implement responsive, accessible components in React + TypeScript + Tailwind, using Radix UI / shadcn patterns.
Shape complex UX
: Partner with Product, Eng, and AI/ML to design clear interactions for real-time, multi-user features.
Evolve our design system
: Drive tokens, theming, documentation, and component APIs for scalability and consistency.
Design with AI in the loop
: Integrate AI-assisted design-to-code workflows and author patterns that our agents can reliably compose.
Polish the feel
: Add motion, micro-interactions, and states that improve comprehension—not just aesthetics.
Collaborate in real time
: Help build collaborative UX using Liveblocks/WebSockets, optimizing presence, conflict-resolution, and latency.
Ship accessible, fast UI
: Ensure that all designs adhere to accessibility standards, keep Core Web Vitals green, and measure UX with meaningful product metrics.
Must-haves
Portfolio of shipped, product-quality UI that demonstrates strong visual taste and systems thinking. We care less about
where
you’ve worked or
how long
you’ve been there, and more about what you can create, the rigor behind your process, and the clarity of your outcomes. Case studies should highlight not only polished visuals, but also your approach to design systems, interaction patterns, accessibility, and measurable product impact.
Fluency with Figma (flows, prototypes, component props/variants).
Experience building within a design system (tokens, theming, component APIs).
Strong grasp of UX principles, interaction design, and accessibility fundamentals.
Interest in AI-augmented workflows (promptable components, agent-safe patterns).
Nice-to-haves
Hands-on with React, TypeScript, Tailwind, Radix/shadcn in production.
Animation & interaction craft (Framer Motion, CSS keyframes, spring physics).
Real-time collaboration UX (CRDTs, optimistic UI, presence patterns).
Testing and quality: Storybook, Playwright/Jest, a11y tooling (axe, aria-lint).
Mobile mindset: Expo/React Native or responsive patterns beyond breakpoints.
What We Offer
Competitive salary
— aligned with the impact you bring.
Equity ownership
in one of Canada’s fastest-growing AI startups.
In-house team environment
with lunch provided 3 days a week.
Flexible vacation & sick policy
— we care about you being at your best, not just at your desk.
Quarterly team events & outings
to celebrate wins and build stronger connections.
AboutTempo

jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role
As a Product Engineer at Mocha, your primary challenge will be making complex technical concepts intuitive and approachable for non-technical users. You'll design experiences that abstract away the complexity of web development, turning intimidating concepts like APIs, databases, and deployment into simple, understandable interactions. This means crafting educational flows, building interfaces that make technical decisions feel effortless, and creating feedback systems that help without overwhelming. We win if we're the most approachable platform for non-technical users, and you'll work across our full stack with that guiding principle: "how do we make this feel simple and empowering for someone who's never written code?”
💡What you’ll do
We’re looking for high ownership, which means nothing is out of scope. With that said, here are a few things we consider priority for this role:
Define, design, and build new features across the stack that make shipping powerful products possible for non-technical users (eg, analytics, AI integrations, payments, etc)
Reinvent existing features that are still too technical for our target audience (eg, dev vs prod environments, DB migration failures, AI debugging UX) with better educational flows and clearer feedback
Improve our instrumentation to develop a deeper understanding of user pain points, detailed AI success / failure rates, and generally where we fall short. Follow this up by proposing and implementing solutions to problems surfaced by said instrumentation
Reduce time to value for new users. AI-app generation can take 30s or more. Help us build experiences that get users to something impressive instantly
Refine core agent experience, reducing failures and improving UX for cases where the AI does fail. Prevent users from “doom loops”
Build a Figma-like experience for directly editing objects in the UI without writing code or asking the AI. Enhance with contextual AI edits by selecting sections of the DOM
Assist growth efforts, implementing funnels or other needs from the Growth team
🛠️ Our tools
We use a modern and
very fun
stack of tools:
Our backend is written in Elixir using the Phoenix web framework. Our Frontend is a TypeScript, React SPA using Vite.
Postgres, Cloudflare R2 for object storage
Fly.io
for user sandboxes (
https://fly.io/customers/mocha
)
Cloudflare for user production deployments
Claude and Gemini for most of our AI, with experiments that leverage other models / platforms like Grok and OpenAI
🔍 What we’re looking for
Self-sufficient, high-ownership engineers. We’re small and lean, we work closely together when we can, but we also need people who can drive things forward on their own
You have 5-10 years of experience
Frontend-leaning, full stack engineer. Prior experience with Elixir not necessary, but you should be excited to learn it
Excellent communication
You use AI as a powerful productivity tool while maintaining strong engineering judgment, never letting it replace your own critical thinking
One trait we value highly: our engineers tend to always leave the code base better than when they found it. Each step of the way, they’re making small, incremental improvements. These efforts compound into robust and maintainable systems over time
Why join Mocha
We’re small and lean yet we are in a high-growth stage. Getting in now is as high-impact and high-reward as it gets
Well-funded
We get to work on a problem with a solution that wasn’t possible more than a year ago
The market we’re in is very large, making big outcomes more likely
Compensation & Benefits
Competitive salary and equity
— multiple options based on your desire for ownership
Hardware setup
— new MacBook Pro, big display, and accessories.
Unlimited vacation
(with startup work-life balance).
Hybrid flexible schedule
3 days onsite in SF.
Opportunity to work on something really big.
About the interview
Technical discussion:
You’ll chat with our CTO about your technical background and dive into a project together.
Behavioral and cultural fit
: You’ll chat with our CEO about your work style to try to determine if it’s a good mutual fit.
Programming exercise: we’ll set you up with a real programming problem (not a leetcode exercise). You hack on it for 90mins and then we debrief / pair together on the result
AboutMocha
Join us at Mocha
We're building the future of building web applications. Our vision is
personal software
: just like personal computing put an iPhone in everyone's pocket, we believe AI has unlocked the potential for everyone to create their own custom applications, as they need them.
Our platform is an online website builder powered by a state-of-the-art AI agent. For our customers however, what matters is that they can finally bring their ideas to life and share them with the world, no coding required.
Everyone is going to be a builder. Help us make that faster.
Join us!

jobs.title: AI Prompt & Product Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role
About the Role
We’re hiring an
AI Prompt & Product Engineer
to help turn cutting-edge AI into real impact in healthcare. You’ll be responsible for shaping how our platform thinks, speaks, and solves problems — from designing prompts and fine-tuning models to scoping MVPs and testing new AI workflows.
In an early-stage startup, no two days look the same. Some days you’ll be experimenting with multi-agent setups or refining intake flows; others you’ll be pressure-testing our platform, breaking it on purpose, and helping translate ambitious client ideas into something we can ship in weeks, not months. If you enjoy blending engineering, product, and experimentation — this role is for you.
What You’ll Do
Prompt Design & Model Development
Craft and refine prompts that support healthcare tasks like scheduling, eligibility checks, patient education, and intake.
Contribute to
fine-tuning
by preparing datasets, running training jobs, and evaluating results.
Explore new model behaviors and compare approaches across LLMs.
Build internal tools and scripts to test and benchmark prompts at scale.
Product Discovery & Workflow Design
Translate broad client requests into focused, testable solutions.
Work with clinicians and staff to uncover bottlenecks and identify the core workflows worth automating.
Break down complex problems into phased rollouts that let us learn quickly while reducing risk.
Prototype new use cases and validate them with real users.
Testing & Quality Assurance
Be the
first user and toughest critic
of our AI platform.
Design testing scenarios that catch edge cases and failure modes early.
Define metrics to measure conversation quality, accuracy, and user trust.
Stress-test new features, models, and integrations before release.
Engineering & Technical Leadership
Contribute directly to product code with
Python/JavaScript
for automation, integrations, and evaluation pipelines.
Partner with engineers on architecture and deployment decisions.
Identify opportunities to apply emerging AI techniques (RAG, multi-agent orchestration, lightweight fine-tuning).
Explain technical trade-offs clearly to both internal and external stakeholders.
What You Bring
Core Experience
2+ years in
AI/ML engineering, product engineering, or similar roles
(startup or fast-paced environments a plus).
Hands-on experience with
LLMs, prompt engineering, and evaluation
.
Proficiency in
Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript
.
A track record of turning complex requirements into shipped products.
Comfort with hypothesis-driven development and rapid iteration.
Technical Background
Knowledge of
AI frameworks, APIs, and fine-tuning techniques
.
Understanding of conversational AI design and multi-agent systems.
Familiarity with A/B testing and metrics-driven decision-making.
Ability to collaborate closely with engineers on system design and implementation.
Nice to Have
Background in
healthcare technology or regulated environments
.
Familiarity with standards like HL7/FHIR or insurance workflows.
Awareness of compliance requirements (HIPAA, SOC 2).
Interest in AI safety, reliability, and alignment.
Who You Are
You thrive in ambiguity and enjoy experimenting your way to clarity.
You want to see AI solve
real, human problems in healthcare
, not just toy use cases.
You’re comfortable moving between roles — one day coding, the next mapping out workflows with clinicians.
You believe speed, learning, and responsibility go hand in hand.
About the Role
We’re looking for a Prompt Engineer to join our early-stage healthcare AI startup. In this role, you’ll design, test, and optimize prompts and workflows that power real-world use cases such as patient scheduling, insurance eligibility and prior auth, medical history collection, and patient education. You’ll also contribute to model fine-tuning and evaluation to ensure outputs meet the accuracy, compliance, and usability standards needed in healthcare. Expect to wear many hats — from prototyping prompts to coding integrations — as we rapidly iterate and scale.
Key Responsibilities
Design, refine, and test prompts to enable accurate and reliable outputs for healthcare scheduling, insurance workflows, patient intake, and education.
Build and maintain reusable prompt libraries and evaluation frameworks to improve performance and reproducibility.
Contribute to fine-tuning models (collecting and curating datasets, running training jobs, evaluating outputs) to improve domain-specific accuracy.
Write code to automate testing, integrate AI workflows into APIs and applications, and monitor performance in production.
Collaborate directly with clinicians and operations teams to understand real-world pain points and rapidly prototype solutions.
Establish quality guardrails to ensure safety, compliance, and trust in patient-facing outputs.
Contribute to broader product development beyond prompts—helping with data pipelines, integrations, and deployment.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or related field (or equivalent startup experience).
Proficiency in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript for scripting, automation, and API integration.
Hands-on experience with large language models (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.) and prompt design.
Familiarity with fine-tuning workflows (data preprocessing, evaluation metrics, supervised/LoRA training, or similar).
Strong problem-solving skills and creativity in working with language and workflows.
Excellent communication skills to translate between technical, clinical, and operational needs.
Comfort operating in a fast-paced startup environment with limited structure.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with healthcare data standards and workflows (EHR, HL7/FHIR, insurance claims).
Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and deployment best practices.
Familiarity with compliance frameworks (HIPAA, SOC 2).
Experience working cross-functionally in small teams where responsibilities overlap.
What We’re Looking For
Entrepreneurial mindset — resourceful, adaptable, and eager to experiment.
Excitement about applying AI to reduce friction in healthcare access and operations.
Willingness to roll up your sleeves and contribute wherever needed — from prompt design to coding to dataset prep for fine-tuning.
AboutSimbie AI
Simbie Health is on a mission to solve discharge. Transitions of care - any time a patient moves from one medical facility to another or to home - is fraught with vulnerability and many patients fall through the cracks. By developing the a tech-enabled platform focused on intercepting patients at discharge, we aim to ensure every patient transitions smoothly from their hospitalization to their homes. Working at Simbie, you’ll have the chance to innovate at one of the single most fraught and costly moments for patients in US healthcare: the transitions.
Simbie is founded by Natalia Khosla MD MSc, a physician from UChicago and Fulbright Scholar in Gender & Healthy Equity; Rachel O'Driscoll, a healthcare operations leader who ran US operations at Carrot Fertility and launched a tech-enabled clinic at Cayaba Care; and Natalia Perina, a software engineer from Princeton who led the patient recruitment product and data teams at TrialSpark.

jobs.title: Founding Full-Stack Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role
About Roame
Our mission is to make travel perfect. Roame is a flight search engine using credit card points and miles. More than $69 billion worth of points issued every year. We empower over 1 million travelers to maximize the value of their points and miles.
We are backed by top investors including Y Combinator, Goodwater, Accel’s starters fund, and angel investors including the leading figure within points.
The Role
We are hiring for a Lead Full Stack Engineer who thrives in a fast-paced, ownership-driven environment. If you're
passionate about travel, aviation, and the world of credit card points
and miles—and you're excited to build from the ground up—this is your opportunity.​
As our first product-focused engineering hire, you'll work directly with the CTO and collaborate closely with our engineering team. This is a hands-on role where you'll lead both frontend and backend development, contributing across the stack—from product design to growth initiatives. We value a strong sense of ownership and a willingness to take initiative.​
You will be the jack of all trades for frontend and backend.
This position is based in San Francisco and requires in-person work five days a week.
What You'll Do
Own the development of our frontend application end-to-end, primarily using Next.js on Vercel.
Collaborate with the team to implement changes aligned with company goals.
Balance technical debt with engineering best practices, working backward from our objectives.
Contribute to backend development using Firebase and Go.
Explore and implement AI pipelines as part of our technology stack.
Bring a keen eye for design, focusing on user-friendly interfaces and iterative improvements.
Embrace rapid iteration cycles and quickly adapt to new ideas and knowledge.
What are we looking for?
A strong interest in travel and credit card points/miles.
4+ years of engineering experience (0-1 experience is great, but we want to see production experience); personal project counts (with large amounts of users counts!)
Have shown initiative to start outside of job projects in the relevant field, we love seeing cool personal projects with scale
You own the frontend app development from end-to-end with no guidance needed. We expect you to push us to move faster
We’re using NextJS on Vercel, Firebase, Go for data backend.
Interest and understanding in AI pipelines with experience in building them.
Good eye for design
and then implementing it and reiterating it, keep pushing! This does
not
mean picture perfect color or pixel pushing, but you know what makes it easy for folks to use.
Comfort with fast-paced iteration and continuous learning.
Work in-person 5 days a week in San Francisco with lunch
Why join Roame?
Join us as we fundamentally change the world of travel and points
Salary Range: $150,000 - $215,000
Equity: 0.5% to 1.25%
Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage
Flexible Spending Account (FSA) available
Generous 401(k) with matching
Commuter benefits
Free lunches at our San Francisco office
Company offsites featuring business-class travel and luxury hotels (using points, naturally)
Our company culture, or why you may or may not be excited about joining us:
Strong work ethic is a significant competitive advantage
As a startup we are trying to change the world and take on many large competitors. If this were easy, everyone would be doing it. Raw hours make a huge difference when facing overwhelming odds. We believe that having a strong work ethic is a competitive advantage, and we expect everyone at Roame to put in their best effort when they’re at work.
Going above and beyond
Have an idea? Disagree with folks (founders)? Action speaks orders of magnitude louder than words, show us. Speaking up is not for everyone, but building to prove/disprove is. Our job is to delight our customers, anything to make their lives magical is in line with our mission. We got here because lightning struck the same place multiple times, but not without taking the first step. We can’t resist passion especially when it grows greater than ours.
Take ownership and be accountable
We can rely on each member of the team to get their work done. When we say we'll do something - we get it done without anyone checking in on us. This way, we can establish a culture of trust and not micromanage each other. We are as strong as our weakest link and we aim to help one another to complete our tasks.
Be Nice
We’re a family here, be nice to each other. We follow radical candor to get things done, we are a no-passive-aggressive shop, truth is hard to swallow, doesn’t mean it has to be delivered with malice. Egos are left at home, kindness is how we support each other. We are always improving at this.
No filibustering; Disagree and commit
We can disagree and commit. Not all of our ideas will be implemented, and sometimes the group will decide to do something one of us disagrees with. Even if we disagree with the decision, we commit to getting it done. It's counterproductive to keep arguing and slow down implementation efforts; better to get it done quickly and see if it actually works instead of speculating otherwise.
About the interview
An hour-long Phone Screen -> Basic Algorithms, Data Structures, and Architecture are all fair game. We care about past experiences and your lessons from them.
If all goes well with the phone screen, we would like to move on with an open-ended take home assignment, usually completed within the week.
Culture Interview -> It's important you're passionate about what we do, and we want to make sure Roame is the best place for your career growth and your interests.
Offer stage
AboutRoame
Roame is Google Flights for your credit card points and miles. We search across airlines to find the best flight redemptions to help users maximize their points.

jobs.title: Founding GTM Leader (Sales)
jobs.description:
About the role
About Pure
Pure is building the future of rare coin and precious metal trading. We believe collectors and investors deserve financial infrastructure that matches the standards of modern markets. That is why we are creating a new kind of order book marketplace that brings transparency, efficiency, and trust to an industry still rooted in legacy systems.
Started in 2023, Pure is one of the fastest growing marketplaces for tangible assets. We currently process over $45 million in transactions each month and are expanding rapidly. Our mission is to modernize an old industry by combining the reliability of traditional trading systems with the innovation of cutting-edge technology.
What You Will Be Doing:
Lead Pure’s go-to-market efforts as the first sales hire, responsible for acquiring new merchants (dealers, institutions, collectors) to join the marketplace.
Build and own the merchant acquisition strategy: prospecting, outreach, pipeline development, and deal closing.
Develop relationships with key stakeholders in the precious metals and rare coin ecosystem, understanding their business needs and positioning Pure as the trusted partner.
Collaborate with product, operations, and leadership to refine merchant onboarding, feedback loops, and growth strategies.
Create repeatable sales processes, playbooks, and metrics that will form the foundation of Pure’s future commercial team.
Represent Pure at industry events, trade shows, and in direct conversations with high-value merchants.
Report directly to the founders on sales performance, pipeline health, and strategic opportunities.
Who You Are:
5+ years of experience in sales, business development, or go-to-market roles, ideally in financial services, fintech, marketplaces, or related industries.
Proven track record of sourcing, negotiating, and closing high-value B2B partnerships or merchant accounts.
Comfortable as a player-coach who is willing to do the work of prospecting and closing, while also building the systems for scale.
Entrepreneurial and resourceful: able to operate in a fast-paced, unstructured environment.
Excellent communicator and relationship builder: able to gain trust with merchants, understand their needs, and deliver solutions.
Data-driven and metrics-oriented: you measure progress, optimize efforts, and refine processes.
Passion for building from the ground up and being part of an early-stage team.
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience working with dealers, collectors, or financial institutions.
Previous success at a marketplace, trading platform, or fintech company.
Understanding of commodities, collectibles, or high-value asset markets.
Experience building and scaling sales teams.
What We Offer:
Health coverage & insurance: Medical, dental
Retirement: 401(k) with employer match
Extras & perks: Daily lunches, Wellness stipend
Location:
Los Angeles, CA - In-Person; 50-75% travel
We move fast. We prioritize accuracy, security, and reliability. Ownership matters. You will have autonomy and be expected to lead and follow through. If you are excited and can do core things well, even if you do not match every box, apply.
AboutPure
We are building a marketplace for rare coins and precious metals. Yes, physical coins, are made of Gold, Silver, Platinum, and palladium. We go against the grain of the industry, which is archaic and largely offline. We strive for Transparency, Liquidity, and Simplicity in the marketplace.

About the role
Find your maximum velocity.
SafetyKit is group of engineers, designers, and operators committed to deploying AI into the world's largest companies as quickly as possible.
It's going to happen, and we're not going to watch it from the sidelines.
We're obsessive builders. We couldn't stop coding if we tried. We chose SafetyKit over cushy big tech jobs because we're tired of moving at the speed of consensus. We want to know what our maximum velocity is.
We're not afraid of big customers, high scale, and high expectations. We know that impact is denominated in dollars — we care about creating real, visible economic change inside the world's largest companies.
We want to learn from the best. We're former and future founders. Some of us are pedigreed (Stripe, Netflix, MIT, Yale), some of us aren't. Some of us are 14-year staff engineers, some of us are on day one.
It's working — some of the biggest companies in the world depend on the work we do every day. But it's still early. 99.9% of the value we'll ever produce is ahead of us.
If this sounds like the life you want to live, let's talk.
What we care about
Speed up.
The future is waiting on us. Don’t do tomorrow what you can do today. Find the minimum effective dose and move on to the next problem.
Obsess.
Reality has a surprising amount of detail.
Go deeper. Love your work — even the stuff that other people find unbearably boring
Decouple and trust.
We are a tightly-bound team of autonomous operators. We maintain a high bar so we can move fast with high trust. We support and teach each other every day.
Some of our past interns
Built AI agents to autonomously investigate signup flows
Built a classifier to determine if marketplace products are drop-shipped
Built a classifier to identify IP violations deployed on some of the world’s largest marketplaces
About you
You love language models.
You code and ship at very high velocity.
You aren’t scared to use codegen models to code and ship even faster.
You act like an owner in everything you do.
People tell you you pick things up unusually quickly.
You care about your work and you care about moving fast. A lot.
You know more than you need to know. You have an insatiable curiosity.
AboutSafetyKit
SafetyKit replaces human content moderators with language models. Companies like
Character.ai
, Substack, Upwork, Faire, and Eventbrite use SafetyKit to find and remove bad stuff on their platform without hurting good users.
We’re ex-Stripe and Airbnb, repeat founders, and have deep connections and experience in our space. We work together in-person every day in a sunny office in the Mission in San Francisco.

About the role
We’ve hit $1M ARR with 200+ paying customers and strong investor backing.
You’ll be our first sales hire, shaping how we grow to $10M+ ARR
.
You’ll work directly with the founders to define and lead our commercial motion, owning relationships, closing strategic new business, and laying the foundation for a high-performing GTM team.
This role is ideal for someone who wants outsized ownership and can step up and figure things out as we shape the sales playbook and team.
If you’ve been looking for a career-defining role where you build, sell, and lead from the ground up, this is it.
About Converge
Converge is building the
unified marketing measurement stack for online stores
. We make it easy for marketeers to understand where their customers come from, cut unprofitable channels, and scale when things are working.
We combine customer data collection, consent management, identity resolution, marketing attribution, data forwarding, and analytics into a single platform.
Converge is backed by Y Combinator (S23), General Catalyst, and founders of Posthog, Algolia, Shipbob, Showpad, etc. We power the customer data infrastructure of 180+ ecommerce customers ranging from small DTC stores to publicly traded online retailers.
Responsibilities
This role combines account management with new business development. You will start by owning relationships with our most important customers and gradually increase your focus on acquiring new logos.
Account Management
Own Customer Relationships
: Serve as the primary post-sale contact for high-value accounts, ensuring ROI realization, adoption, and retention.
Drive Renewals
: Take full ownership of renewal conversations, mitigating churn risk and implementing proactive retention strategies.
Upsell & Expand
: Identify and execute upsell motions and expansion opportunities to increase account value.
Be a Marketing Measurement Expert
: Advise customers on attribution, conversion tracking, and reporting strategies, positioning yourself as a trusted technical partner.
Champion Customer Needs
: Collect feedback and partner with Product to influence roadmap decisions.
New Business (Full-Cycle)
Prospect & Prioritize
: Build and manage a pipeline of ICP accounts through outbound and inbound.
Consultative Discovery
: Deeply understand each prospect’s pain points and underlying technical issues.
Lead Demos as a Technical Expert
: Deliver compelling product demos that address both business and technical requirements.
Proposal & Negotiation
: Own pricing discussions and contract negotiations through to signed agreements and revenue realization.
Build the Playbook
: Develop repeatable sales processes, outbound strategies, and collateral to scale the motion.
You will thrive in this role if you
Are curious and technical
: You love understanding complex products deeply and can become a marketing measurement expert quickly.
Thrive in ambiguity
: You enjoy building processes from scratch and figuring things out without a playbook.
Are commercially minded
: You know how to uncover customer needs and tie solutions to real business value.
Bring a professional, detail-oriented approach
: You’re organized, consultative, hyper responsive, and great at managing multiple stakeholders.
Have sales experience
: You’ve successfully carried quota as an AE or AM.
Have Martech experience
: Experience selling to marketing teams or personal experience working with Martech software.
This role is not for you if you
Think selling alone is enough without becoming an expert
: Our customers choose us because we deeply understand their technical challenges.
Prefer certainty over upside
: There are no rigid benchmarks or career tracks here - just big upside for overachievers.
Don't like working hard
: This role demands more commitment and agency than a typical AE role because it is critical to our success.
Prefer remote over in-person
: We believe being in-person helps us move faster.
What we offer
Competitive OTE with strong upside: base with uncapped commission and aggressive accelerators.
Equity designed to reflect early-stage contribution and long-term upside.
Career-defining opportunity to build and lead the GTM function from the ground up.
Private health, dental, and vision insurance.
Pension & 401k contributions.
Interview process*
Application
: We're looking to see how your skills and experience align with our needs.
Intro interview
(30-min): Our goal is to learn more about what you are looking for in your next role, explore your motivations to join our team, why you would be a great fit, and answer questions about us.
Culture interview
(45-min): We will walk through your experience and background in detail.
Case interview
(1 hour): We will simulate a real customer situation to evaluate discovery, problem-solving, and ability to articulate value.
Offer
If everyone’s aligned, we’ll move quickly to make you an offer.
(*) can be done in 2 days, just flag to us that you want to do it fast.

Converge is building the unified marketing measurement stack for online stores. We make it easy for marketeers to understand where their customers come from, cut unprofitable channels, and scale when things are working.
We scaled to
$1M+ in ARR
, now serving 180+ customers (including publicly listed companies). All the while, we kept our team
very small with just 1 engineer

jobs.title: ML Research Scientist
jobs.description:
About the role
ML Research Scientist - Guac
At Guac, we're solving grocery food waste with predictive ML. We predict exactly how much of each product will sell, helping grocery retailers order/produce the perfect amount of inventory.
The grocery industry is enormous (in the US, it accounts for 4% of GDP), and grocery food waste is one of the biggest drivers of cost for retailers, but also a huge problem for the climate and food security.
Today, we're working with major supermarket chains in the US (you've probably shopped at some of them before), and we've scaled to 7-figures in ARR. We're also backed by leading investors such as Y Combinator, 1984 Ventures, Collaborative Fund, and angels from Instacart and Citadel Securities.
We've brought together an exceptional team from Palantir, BCG, Oxford, Cambridge, and MIT to solve intellectually challenging problems and tackle food insecurity & waste with technology.
We're looking for a talented ML Research Scientist in NYC to join our mission.
About the Role
As an ML Research Scientist at Guac, you'll be at the forefront of developing cutting-edge machine learning models that power our demand forecasting and inventory optimization systems. You'll tackle complex, multi-dimensional problems involving perishable goods, supply chain dynamics, and retail operations at unprecedented scale.
Your work will directly impact millions of dollars in inventory decisions across major grocery chains, helping reduce food waste while ensuring customers have access to fresh products. This is a highly experimental role where intellectual curiosity and methodological rigor will drive measurable business outcomes.
Core Responsibilities:
Advanced Forecasting Models:
Design and implement state-of-the-art ML models for demand forecasting at store, chain, and warehouse levels, accounting for seasonality, promotions, weather, and complex interaction effects
Operations Research:
Develop optimization algorithms for multi-supplier sourcing decisions, case size optimization, recipe planning, and inventory allocation across distribution networks
Predictive Analytics:
Build sophisticated models for current stock prediction, shelf-life optimization, and spoilage prevention using real-time data streams
Research & Experimentation:
Lead independent research initiatives to push the boundaries of what's possible in retail forecasting, with freedom to explore novel approaches and methodologies
Model Validation:
Design and execute rigorous A/B testing frameworks to validate model improvements and measure real-world impact on waste reduction and customer satisfaction
Technical Environment:
You'll work with our modern ML infrastructure built on Dagster for data orchestration, Dask and Coiled for distributed computing, and PyTorch and XGBoost for model development. Our data spans millions of SKUs, hundreds of stores, and billions of transactions.
Success Metrics:
Your primary measure of success will be forecast accuracy improvements that translate directly to reduced food waste and increased profitability for our retail partners. We expect you to consistently identify and implement improvements that move key business metrics.
About You
Required:
4+ years of experience in applied machine learning research, preferably in forecasting, optimization, or operations research
Deep expertise in time series forecasting, with hands-on experience in PyTorch, XGBoost, or similar frameworks
Strong mathematical foundation in optimization, probability, and statistics
Proven track record of taking research ideas from conception to production deployment
Highly Desirable:
Experience with inventory optimization, supply chain analytics, or retail forecasting
Background in operations research, particularly multi-stage optimization and stochastic programming
PhD in a quantitative field (Machine Learning, Operations Research, Statistics, Economics, or related) or equivalent industry experience
Experience with distributed computing frameworks (Dask, PySpark, etc.)
Publication record in top-tier ML/OR conferences or journals
Experience working in high-growth startup environments where research directly impacts business outcomes
What We Offer
Impactful Research:
Work on problems that directly address climate change and food security
Intellectual Freedom:
Significant autonomy to explore novel approaches and drive research directions
Compensation:
$180k-$220k base + competitive equity
Fully employer-paid healthcare
(medical, dental, and vision)
Unlimited vacation days
Fully covered food expenses
in the office (lunch/dinner)
Free Equinox membership
Conference & Research Budget:
Support for attending top ML/OR conferences and continuing education
Our Tech Stack
ML & Research:
PyTorch, XGBoost, Scikit-learn, NumPy, SciPy
Data & Orchestration:
Dagster, Dask, Coiled, Pandas, BigQuery
Backend:
Python, FastAPI
Cloud & Infrastructure:
GCP, Postgres, Terraform, Docker
Frontend:
React, Next.js, TypeScript
AboutGuac
Guac uses machine learning to do demand forecasting for grocers. We predict exactly how much of each product grocers will sell, on each day, at each of their stores.
Our mission is to put an end to the millions of tons of food that goes to waste every single day due to bad inventory planning.

jobs.title: Design Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role
About Empirical Health
We're building the future of primary care. 99% of your health is defined outside the doctor’s office. Empirical helps you manage it.
Empirical Health is a virtual-first medical service that uses artificial intelligence and health sensors on wearable devices (Apple Watch, Fitbit, Google Pixel, Samsung watch and more) to scale proactive healthcare to everyone. We're building a product that gives every user an AI-powered personal health assistant, backed by a real human doctor who can provide actual diagnosis, treatment, and care.
In this role you will work with our doctors and interact with real patients to build the tools needed to keep them healthy. Do you want to use your software engineering and design skills to save lives and make healthcare better for everyone? At Empirical Health, we're inventing the future of primary care – and we want you.
About the role
From blueprint to breakthrough, Design Engineers are responsible for the core of Empirical Health: our patient-facing mobile app.
Some examples of what you might do:
Craft an intuitive data visualization to help our patients understand their overall health score (based on a formula created by a doctor), how their health is changing, and what actions have the highest impact in improving their health.
Design GenAI UI patterns that go beyond chat.
Launch new features for our mobile app to help improve our AI generated care plans for patients with different conditions such as POTS, hypertension, or sleep apnea.
Design and build flows that help patients understand tradeoffs in cost and quality between different options (for example, an in-lab sleep apnea testing can cost $3,000 vs $200 for an at-home test).
We expect design engineers to push code to production in the first week and complete a major project that improves the lives of real patients by the end of the first 1-2 months.
This job is in person 5 days a week in New York City (Union Square in Manhattan), but hybrid/remote days can be arranged when necessary.
About you
We’re looking for someone with strong UI engineering skills and an obsession with design to ship real features for our users.
Ideally, you have:
Strong knowledge of TypeScript or JavaScript and React or React Native.
A strong desire to make an impact on the healthcare system
A high level of skill in interaction design, usability, and data visualization.
Excellence in the basics: simple code, reasonable automated tests, code reviews, clear comments, and quick iteration cycles.
Strong owner's mindset.
Nice to haves:
Experience with mobile interface design (e.g., iOS Human Interface Guidelines).
Exposure to healthcare, bioinformatics, or digital health is helpful, but if you're willing to learn, we're willing to teach.
Visual design or motion design.
Technologies we work with
React Native (mobile app), Node.js (server), and TypeScript (both)
PostgreSQL (database)
Swift and Kotlin (native modules in iOS and Android)
Why work with us
We ship
—we don’t do year-long projects that are outdated before they’re even finished. We ship incrementally, so that we’re constantly testing whether our product direction resonates with real users.
Our work has deep impact
. We directly help people–often with serious illnesses like Long Covid or heart disease–live healthier lives. We’re focused on real patient care, not the back office.
We’re small, on purpose.
We’re a team of 4 people, even though we’ve raised enough capital to hire more. We believe a small team with high agency and skill can accomplish great things.
Experienced founding team
. Our founders include a UC San Francisco Assistant Professor and a serial entrepreneur who scaled their previous startup to 10 million users.
Wear multiple hats.
We believe the boundaries between design, product, and engineering are porous and flexible, and we embrace people who are interdisciplinary.
About the interview
Our interview process consists of 2 phone interviews, with finalists moving to a half-day onsite. The interviews will cover:
Interaction design
Coding and debugging in Typescript or Javascript
Data visualization
Styling (in CSS, Tailwind, or RN StyleSheets depending on previous experience)
Portfolio review
AboutEmpirical Health
We're building the future of primary care.
Primary care is the quarterback of the healthcare system–the doctor whose job is to keep you healthy. The best primary care available today can prevent 1 in 2 hospitalizations, but requires 5x as many doctors. That won’t scale to our country, let alone our world.
Empirical Health is using artificial intelligence, health sensors, and value-based payment models to scale proactive primary care to everyone. We’re building a product that gives every user an AI-powered personal health assistant, backed by a real human doctor who can provide actual diagnosis, treatment, and care.

jobs.title: Product Operations Associate
jobs.description:
About the role
What we do
We believe accessing healthcare should be as simple as doing your taxes on TurboTax.
But for the millions on Medicaid, it’s not.
People lose coverage because of administrative barriers—like missing a notice and incorrect documentation. 60–70% of disenrollments in Medicaid happen for these procedural reasons. These are avoidable errors caused by fragmented systems, not ineligibility.
What you’ll do
As an early member of the product operations team at Fortuna, you’ll play a critical role in building a best-in-class consumer product. We work fully in-person 5 days a week out of our NYC office, and believe deeply in the value of a focused, supportive, and tight-knit team.
Your main responsibilities as a product ops associate will include:
Process Operations
- Ensure we can scale volume across numerous states, working closely with Engineering to streamline processes:
Review and process high volumes of consumer applications, tracking learnings and patterns for Engineering
Understand nuances / edge cases across state and Medicaid programs (no prior experience necessary)
Identify patterns in user behavior across the full product to collaborate with engineering on product features and address bugs
Consumer Operations
- Ensure our Fortuna consumers have the best experience:
Provide timely, empathetic, and high-quality consumer support
Understand and investigate consumer needs and pain points
Collaborate with engineering to identify opportunities to improve user experience and reduce support needs
This role may be for you if…
You want to move fast and learn faster at a startup. You’ll thrive here if you see startups as the ultimate launchpad for your career and want to get deep in the weeds of building. You’ll get exposure to early‑stage company building, working across Operations and Engineering. You’ll have a unique opportunity to influence what we build and how we build it. Some words we think of when we think of our ideal fit: scrappy, high-grit, reliable, resourceful, open-minded, humble, and empathetic
What we’re looking for
Product Mindset
Our philosophy is that everyone should be product-oriented. We’re fundamentally building a consumer product for the masses. As such, we’re looking for a teammate who’s motivated by delivering a seamless, user-centered experience. Our users are everything to us - and you have the power to ensure they have an exceptional experience. If you’ve ever gone out of your way to anticipate someone’s needs, or built systems to make life easier for a busy team, you’ll fit right in.
Ownership
You’ll be trusted to fully execute on goals we set for the team. We have so much to build, it’s important that you are excited to own entire pieces of that. To us, high ownership looks like persistence and resourcefulness, combined with deep knowledge of the processes you’re executing on.
High Velocity
The bar is high - we’re looking someone who is energized by a commitment to excellence, thrives in detail-oriented environments, and can juggle simultaneous goals. You bring passion, persistence, and dedication to what you do.
Respectful Disagreement
We believe it's crucial to be able to openly disagree with anyone on the team. We are looking for someone who doesn't shy away from conflict, but is respectful and empathetic in their approach and always open to different ideas.
Humility
It's important to be able to admit when you're wrong. We are looking for a low-ego teammate who is able to take failures in stride and grow from them.
Requirements
0-1 years of experience (internships count, recent graduates welcome to apply)
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset. You’ll use numbers to make decisions (Excel/GoogleSheets), but don’t need prior technical experience
Able to work 5 days per week in-person in NYC
What we offer
Competitive salary and equity ownership in the company
Platinum health insurance plans
Free lunch every day
All commuter expenses covered
$100/month wellness benefit
Unlimited PTO
401k plan with company match
Send us a short email (8-10 sentences), including your resume.
Tell us about a time that you owned something that you’re proud of, or about a time you pushed through to make something happen. Feel free to be broad, we’re curious about how you thought and what you did.
AboutFortuna Health
What we do
Fortuna Health is redefining the consumer experience for Medicaid. We’re helping millions navigate Medicaid end-to-end from eligibility and enrollment to renewing coverage. We're backed by a16z, BoxGroup, YC, and top healthcare angels.
Our product is TurboTax for Medicaid. Today, ~90M Medicaid consumers navigate glitchy websites and long paper forms. The experience is so poor that procedural reasons (e.g., form errors, missing a notice in the mail) account for a staggering 75% of dis-enrollments. We believe this can only be solved with a modern and simple UX that is fundamentally consumer-centric.
Creating Value
The problem at the consumer level produces huge downstream consequences: There's over $50B of administrative waste and lost revenue suffered by Medicaid health plans, providers, and states. By making products that consumers want to use, we unlock immense value for these players. Our vision is to become the consumer-facing digital infrastructure that powers the $800B+ Medicaid ecosystem.
Who we are
We each have multiple years of experience in healthtech — Nikita started her career at Oscar and built pharmacy solutions at Truepill (YC S17), Cydney helped scale Halo Dx from seed to series C on the ops side, and Ben was the first engineer at Juniper (YC W21) where he helped scale the engineering team to 12. We have all had direct experience with Medicaid throughout our careers and have seen firsthand the challenges that affect the population.
We started Fortuna because we care about impact — the abysmal state of the Medicaid consumer journey means that the most underserved people in America can't access the benefits that they need and are entitled to. We believe this is a once in a lifetime opportunity to dramatically improve the human condition for 90M people, and we need the help of high-throughput, growth-minded builders to make it happen.

jobs.title: Delivery Manager (AI Product Delivery)
jobs.description:
About the role
Respaid (YC S23) — we're the good guys of B2B collections. Respectful by design, AI-native in practice.
Amazon teams use Respaid to recover revenue without burning relationships.
Backed by Y Combinator and investors including the founders of Docker and Dropbox.
Team ~20 across US & Europe, incl. 10 Ukraine-based engineers. Low ego, high output. We ship weekly and keep everything tight in Linear.
Why this role exists
We move fast — typical hire in 3 days.
Half the team is in Ukraine; your job is to make sure no cycle is wasted on blocked work, ritual overhead, or "what's the priority?" thrash. You spot stalls before standup, turn fuzzy asks into dev-ready slices, and ship small so we learn fast. Direct line to the CEO.
No prior Linear required — become a power-user by Day 7. Verified via a paid 90-min task.
Must-haves
• Ruthless prioritization: carve scope into ≤3h V1 slices; map dependencies; hold the critical path.
• Backlog hygiene: statuses / WIP / Definition of Done; crystal-clear boards & views.
• Execution discipline: crisp acceptance criteria, weekly predictability, fast unblocking under pressure.
• Stakeholder & comms: concise writing + ≤5-min Looms; English C1/C2.
• Technical literacy (non-coding): read API/webhook specs, brief engineers precisely, verify outcomes.
Nice-to-have (not required): exposure to LLM prompt pipelines (test → evaluate/rubrics → QA preview); familiarity with voice/email agents (RetellAI / ElevenLabs or similar); light automations (n8n/Zapier) for coordination.
Process
• Day 0: paid 90-minute kill-test (Linear skeleton + prioritization & hygiene check).
• Day 0 (later): 30-minute debrief (trade-offs, dependencies, risks).
• Day 1–2: paid trial (one Initiative → one 7-day Cycle skeleton; demo snippet).
• Day 3: Offer (fast).
How to apply
Share: (1) a Linear/Notion snapshot of your backlog hygiene (statuses/WIP/DoD/views),
(2) a ≤5-min Loom about a messy project you rescued,
(3) one page on how you split a vague initiative into ≤3h issues with dependencies.
Reply "Accepted — 90-min test" and include today's Loom availability.
About the interview
Day 0 — Paid 90-min kill-test (build Linear skeleton: Initiative → 7-day Cycle → 6–8 issues ≤30m + hygiene note + Loom ≤3m).
Day 0 — 30-min debrief the same day (trade-offs, risks, dependencies).
Day 1–2 — Paid trial (ship a minimal slice; Friday-style demo snippet).
Day 3 — Offer.
AboutRespaid
Hey, we're Respaid. We help businesses recover unpaid B2B invoices faster—with respect. Our AI-powered platform gets 50% of your invoices paid within 20 days, dramatically outperforming traditional agencies. Starting is simple: upload an Excel file, and our system handles the rest—no integration or heavy IT resources needed. We optimize every outreach using data and personalization, protecting your brand's reputation while improving bottom line results.
We serve global companies from high-growth startups to enterprise brands, including DoorDash, Deel, Flexport, Clipboard Health, and Vanta. Today, Respaid is trusted by 750+ customers, used in the US, Europe, and beyond, led from our San Francisco HQ by a diverse, passionate team. Join us as we set a new standard for respectful, effective B2B collections—helping innovative businesses unlock the cash flow they've earned.

About the role
As a Forward Deployed & Product Engineer at Greenlite, you'll build AI agents that help banks and fintechs fight financial crime at massive scale. _

jobs.title: Security Researcher
jobs.description:
About the role
Metalware is a startup dedicated to protecting cyber-physical systems in critical industries. We develop advanced firmware security solutions for industries where failure isn’t an option—ranging from aerospace/defense, automotive, and industrial controls to telecom and healthcare.
We are seeking a Security Researcher with deep embedded security expertise to challenge and secure firmware. In this role, you’ll deploy advanced reverse engineering, fuzzing, and offensive security, and penetration testing techniques to uncover vulnerabilities in complex firmware systems.
WHO YOU ARE
You possess extensive experience in analyzing and exploiting firmware, with a comprehensive understanding of low-level hardware/software interactions.
You are passionate about applying advanced techniques like symbolic execution, memory corruption analysis, and custom exploit development to real-world embedded challenges.
You enjoy engaging directly with cutting-edge customers—from drone and electric vehicle manufacturers to humanoid robot, nuclear reactor, and satellite companies—to understand their challenges and deliver rapid, effective solutions.
You’re comfortable gathering user feedback, understanding requirements, and quickly shipping code.
You want to work side-by-side with the founders to shape product direction and technical roadmap.
You’re passionate about developing high-quality embedded software and own every aspect of the development lifecycle—from design and coding to testing and ongoing support.
RESPONSIBILITIES
Utilize tools like Ghidra, Binary Ninja, and IDA Pro to reverse engineer firmware binaries, dissecting their structure to reveal hidden vulnerabilities and exploitation vectors.
Design and execute targeted fuzzing campaigns, integrating dynamic analysis techniques to stress-test firmware under real-world conditions.
Engineer custom exploit chains to validate discovered vulnerabilities, leveraging techniques such as ROP chain crafting, heap spraying, and memory corruption exploitation.
Collaborate with our engineering and AI teams to translate technical findings into improved product interfaces, detailed vulnerability reports, and intuitive security dashboards that enable rapid remediation.
Stay ahead of emerging threats and attack methodologies by continuously researching cutting-edge techniques in binary analysis, symbolic execution, and adversarial testing, contributing to both internal R&D and external security communities.
Develop prototypes to validate design concepts, quantify technical constraints, and iterate on new ideas.
Gather and incorporate user feedback to continuously improve product features and performance.
MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
Proficient in C, C++, or Rust programming languages.
Demonstrated expertise in reverse engineering and penetration testing within embedded systems.
Hands-on experience with firmware analysis, including the use of tools like Ghidra, Binary Ninja, or IDA Pro.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related STEM discipline with 3+ years of professional software engineering experience; OR 5+ years of professional software engineering experience in lieu of a degree.
IDEAL QUALIFICATIONS
Active participation in CTF competitions or similar high-caliber security challenges.
In-depth knowledge of exploit development techniques, including ROP, heap exploitation, and memory corruption attacks.
Experience integrating security findings into product development, with a keen eye for refining UI and report outputs for clarity and actionability.
A robust understanding of cybersecurity best practices, vulnerability management, and embedded system architectures.
ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS
Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as needed to meet project deadlines and deliverables.
BENEFITS
Competitive salary and equity package.
Full health, vision, and dental benefits.
Opportunities for continuous professional development, including training and conference participation.
AboutMetalware
Metalware develops advanced firmware security solutions for real-time embedded systems, protecting critical industries like aerospace, automotive, industrial control, telecom, medical devices, and IoT from cyber threats.
Our product is an automated, intelligent binary fuzzer that enables organizations to efficiently discover and remediate security weaknesses in embedded software before release or deployment.

jobs.title: Physical Therapist
jobs.description:
About the role
Shasta Health is looking for part-time physical therapists to join our growing team in California. All Shasta Health PTs are independent contractors and get to choose when they want to work, and how they want to work.
Backed by Y Combinator (the testing ground for generational tech companies like AirBnB, Stripe, and DeliveryHero), Shasta Health is building a new platform that handles all of the non-clinical parts of PT (billing, scheduling, marketing, etc.) so PTs earn
3x more
per visit.
About You:
You’re a CA licensed physical therapist who is passionate about patient care across the age spectrum. We’re starting first with the patients who need you most (Medicare - our golden generation) and growing into other patient populations
You’re keen to explore combining outpatient physical therapy with in-home PT benefits, and looking to grow into telehealth in the future
You are looking for a flexible work schedule or an additional side hustle where you have control
You are comfortable treating Medicare patients, and open to working with other patient groups as we grow
The Role:
Direct Patient Care:
You’ll be treating Medicare patients in home and open to expanding into tele-health and other populations.
Flexibility:
Set your own schedule. Choose when and where you want to see patients, though some flexibility will be needed throughout the week.
Contract:
Part-time physical therapists, first as contractors, but with the opportunity to grow into full-time roles in the future as we continue to grow and shape patient care together.
Case Load and Location:
Minimum of 3-5 hours a week, with 4-10 patients seen in-person around your area per week that can flex up or down depending on volume.
State-of-the-art Technology:
Our software platform handles scheduling, documentation, home exercises and insurance & billing. Forget about the paperwork and focus on your patients!
Participate in Tech/Product Development:
You’ll report directly to another experienced clinician, and have direct access to both the CEO and CTO as the voice of both patients and providers, giving input into how the care model and software should work. You’ll also get to experiment with new tech like AI and VR with the goal of making rehab better!
Requirements:
CA State PT license
Willing to treat patients in their homes within a 30-minute driving radius of your location
Nice to Have:
Familiarity with similar documentation systems like WebPT and StrataPT
Experience with patient acquisition
Previous experience with outpatient at home PT services
Residency trained or board certified
Verifiable Medicare Credentialing (NPI number)
Personal transportation + valid driver’s license
Liability insurance
Salary, Benefits and Contract:
$80-150 per hour of patient care
Travel stipend based on volume
1099 contractor - with future opportunities for full-time and internal positions based on your great patient care results
Thank you for considering a career at Shasta Health - we can’t wait to meet you!
AboutShasta Health

Outset invented a better way to do research:
AI-powered user interviews.
We created this new category of research technology and now it's growing wildly.
Global brands like Hubspot, Microsoft, Uber and Nestle use Outset to achieve deeper, qualitative insights about their users at unprecedented speed and scale.

We’ve created an end-to-end, AI-moderated research platform that conducts deep-dive interviews with participants to understand user experiences, evaluate concepts, and test designs. Our AI synthesizes conversational data, delivering precise, actionable insights.

About the role
Job Description
We’re looking for a
Security Researcher
who is passionate about uncovering, analyzing, and preventing vulnerabilities in modern software. This role sits at the intersection of AI, security research, and developer tooling. You’ll help shape how Corgea detects new classes of vulnerabilities and automate secure code analysis at scale.
This is a
remote
position based in the US (preferably in California or the San Francisco Bay Area).
What You’ll Be Doing
Research and design detection methods for emerging vulnerability classes across multiple languages and frameworks.
Analyze source code, binaries, and AI-generated code to identify new exploit patterns and attack surfaces.
Collaborate with our engineering team to integrate your research into Corgea’s AI-driven security engine.
Conduct security evaluations of open-source and enterprise applications to validate and refine Corgea’s models.
Stay current on the latest CVEs, exploit techniques, and security trends to inform product intelligence.
Who You Are
4–8 years of experience in
application security
,
offensive research
, or
secure software development
.
Strong understanding of
vulnerability classes
(e.g., injection, deserialization, path traversal, auth bypass, XXE, SSRF, RCE).
Proficiency in one or more languages such as
Python, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Go, or C/C++
.
Experience with
static or dynamic analysis tools
, fuzzing, or reverse engineering is a plus.
Curiosity about how attackers think—and how AI can help defenders move faster.
Comfortable working autonomously in a fast-paced, research-driven startup.
Why You Should Apply
Competitive salary and equity package (0.50 % – 2.00 %).
Work on cutting-edge problems at the frontier of AI and cybersecurity.
Collaborate directly with leading engineers, researchers, and security experts.
Flexible hybrid schedule aligned with San Francisco time.
Diversity and Inclusion
At Corgea, we’re committed to diversity and inclusion. We assess all applicants based on merit, qualifications, competence, and talent—without discrimination of any kind.
AboutCorgea
Corgea helps engineers ship code and not vulnerabilities. It's an AI-powered SAST, unlike traditional SAST with tons of false positives, Corgea can find vulnerabilities like business logic flaws, API vulnerabilities, and broken authentication with little false positives (<5%). It also writes security fixes for engineers to approve.

jobs.title: Accounting Solutions & Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
About the role
Please note:
This role is required to be based in San Francisco. Our entire team goes into the office 5 days per week and you will be working alongside your peers.
Our Story
Campfire is a next-gen core accounting platform that helps modern mid-market finance teams close fast, and scale faster. We replace outdated legacy ERPs and manual accounting processes with automation-driven solutions that simplify and accelerate finance workflows. With Campfire, finance teams gain clarity, control, and strategic visibility — fast.
Position Overview
As a full-time member of our Customer Experience team, you will play a critical role in driving adoption for Campfire. You'll be the bridge between our clients and our product, ensuring smooth migrations to our product and ongoing support. You'll work closely with new customers to understand their accounting software needs, configure the software accordingly, and provide post-implementation support to help them achieve their accounting and business goals. You will report to the Head of Implementation & Customer Success as part of this role.
Key Responsibilities:
Lead the ERP implementation process for new customers, from kickoff to full go-live.
Migrate customer data from their previous accounting software based on client requirements
Provide training sessions to ensure users are proficient with the software.
Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned accounts, for both of the implementation and post-go live periods.
Drive feature adoption and identify growth opportunities within existing accounts.
Collaborate with product and engineering teams to communicate customer bugs and feature requests.
Develop and maintain implementation best practices and documentation.
Experience:
2+ years of experience in accounting audit, accounting or finance or 2+ years of experience in customer success, implementation, or account management. Strong preference for candidates with experience in an in-house or public accounting role.
Bonus: at least 1 year of experience with ERPs (Quickbooks, Xero, Sage Intacct, Netsuite)
Strong technical aptitude and ability to quickly learn new software platforms
Intermediate-level Microsoft Excel/Google Sheets skills
Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field
Personal Attributes:
Highly proactive, adaptable, and capable of working in a fast-paced environment.
Excellent attention to detail and ability to work under tight deadlines.
Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills.
Problem-solving mindset with the ability to translate customer needs into practical solutions
A growth mindset with a focus on continuous improvement.
AboutCampfire
Campfire is the modern accounting platform for startups and mid-size tech companies. Features include a powerful general ledger, invoicing, billing, revenue accounting and reporting, financial statements, AI-powered conversational reporting, and automated accounting workflows such as bank reconciliation. The product is natively integrated with industry leading solutions such as Ramp, Brex, Rho, Stripe, and has over 100+ API endpoints to build custom integrations and workflows. Campfire is a modern replacement for legacy, small business accounting software and mid-market ERPs.
Campfire's customers range from Seed to Series C with a variety of business models including SaaS, usage, FinTech, consulting and transactions — from startups like Suger and Parallel to mid-size companies like Carbon Direct, Sprig and Delphia.
The company is headquartered in San Francisco and backed by Foundation Capital, Y Combinator and Twenty Two Ventures.

About the role
Synch is the first AI-powered Salesforce system of engagement. We allow enterprises to manage their entire Salesforce environment using natural language prompts paired with delightful user experiences. Create automations, reports, Apex code and data tables using nothing but plain English.
Synch is the fastest way for businesses to build their CRM, allowing them to focus on revenue generation, not system maintenance.
Based in New York City, we’re backed by Y Combinator, Jack Altman, Haystack, and executives from companies like Retool, Ramp, and Superhuman.
The opportunity
As one of Synch's founding engineers, you’ll build software from the ground up that dramatically changes how people interact with their CRM. You’ll own features that are core to the business from day one and have a direct impact on the trajectory of the company.
We’re looking to build an exceptional engineering team. Engineers at Synch will have the autonomy to build things that truly move the business forward while owning design, implementation and everything in between. We’re builders who are passionate about our craft and love shifting problems to products.
Why now?
Legacy enterprise software is complicated to use. Using Salesforce or NetSuite requires companies to hire consultants and employees with certifications just to manage these systems.
What if we could build smarter software? What if we could turn the domain knowledge that these employees have into API's and user interfaces?

Build features end-to-end that reduce the time and domain knowledge required to work across an organization’s many business systems
Solve interesting technical problems and create solutions that are built on top of, and powered by, the recent advancements in AI (GPT-4)

Who you are
You take pride in your work and have a demonstrated track record of shipping high quality products
1 to 5 years of software engineering experience, ideally working across the stack
You want to take things from start to finish. In our case: from first hearing the customer pain point all the way to the actual implementation of the feature
Excited to explore how AI has enabled a new array of possible product experiences that are waiting to be built
You’re looking to move with speed, take ownership and grow in ways that you couldn’t at other places. You’ll get more out of yourself than you thought you had while having the most fun you’ve ever had in your career
